string.name: telemetry_rationale
string.value:
EtchDroid values your privacy and only uses minimal telemetry to investigate app issues.

Be a part of our open-source community—keep telemetry enabled and help improve EtchDroid for everyone!

While we don't collect any personally-identifying information, we believe in transparency and want you to know that opened image file names and USB device IDs are collected anonymously to help diagnose issues with specific hardware. (%s)
